sources.observed: NTFS3.0/3.1 entry definition; declared record size, optional Unicode name, lowest VCN and MFT segment reference; quadword-aligned ordered list. Documentation labels the name-offset and final16-bit field reserved. Do not infer that either must be zero.

The attribute-list entry layout places type at0, length at4, name length/offset at6/7, VCN at8, MFT reference at16, attribute identifier at24 and variable name from26. Its size helper rounds the name-bearing entry to8 bytes. The name accessor follows the declared offset. No implementation is imported or executed.

current_gap: The existing bootstrap explicitly stops on ntfs_mft_attribute_list_unsupported. Attribute-list entry decoding and cross-record extension joining are absent.
next_contract_questions: Preserve raw name units, reference, VCN and identifier/reserved bits; separate bounded structural interpretation from cross-record authority and volume name collation.
Specify exact declared-length/name-span/alignment, truncation, overflow and finite-cursor rules with independent fixtures before implementation.
Do not use a parsed list alone to claim stream completeness, sequence/reference validity or permission to read another source. Extension joining requires its own source-bound record/mapping checks.
